## 📡 INGEST & PARSE
Polls 3 Vollna RSS feeds every 1 min, Extracts job title, description, budget, skills, job ID and clean Upwork URL.

## 🎯 FILTER & DEDUPLICATE
Requires 2+ skill matches to proceed. Skips low-rated clients (below 4.5). Blocks already-processed jobs via Airtable lookup.

## 🤖 GENERATE, SAVE & NOTIFY
GPT-4o-mini generates a personalized 150-250 word proposal using job details + Vivek's profile. Saves everything to Airtable and sends a full Slack notification instantly.
